import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import root
N=150000
k=7
lnN=np.log(N)

def dist(w,eps):
    S=1-eps
    p=np.empty(N)
    p[0]=S*w
    p[1:k]=S*(1-w)/(k-1)
    p[k:]=eps/(N-k)
    return p

def eqs(x):
    w,eps=x
    p=dist(w,eps)
    lp=np.log(p)
    FK=lnN+np.dot(p,lp)
    BK=-lnN-lp.mean()
    return [FK-10.0, BK-10.0]

for w in [0.08,0.1,0.12,0.14,0.142857,0.16,0.18,0.2]:
    r=eqs([w,np.exp(-10)])
    print(w, r)
print('root')
sol=root(eqs,[0.1,np.exp(-10)],method='hybr',options={'xtol':1e-12})
print(sol)
w,eps=sol.x
p=dist(w,eps)
lp=np.log(p)
print('sum',p.sum(),'min',p.min(),'max',p.max())
print('FK',lnN+np.dot(p,lp),'BK',-lnN-lp.mean(),'H',-np.dot(p,lp),'meanlog',lp.mean())
print('w eps',w,eps)

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import root

N = 150_000
K = 7
TARGET_KL = 10.0
TOLERANCE = 0.001
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/dist.npy"
LOG_N = np.log(N)


def build_distribution(weight, tail_mass):
    head_mass = 1.0 - tail_mass
    p = np.empty(N, dtype=np.float64)
    p[0] = head_mass * weight
    p[1:K] = head_mass * (1.0 - weight) / (K - 1)
    p[K:] = tail_mass / (N - K)
    return p


def kl_divergences(p):
    log_p = np.log(p)
    forward = LOG_N + np.dot(p, log_p)
    backward = -LOG_N - np.mean(log_p)
    return forward, backward


def equations(x):
    p = build_distribution(x[0], x[1])
    forward, backward = kl_divergences(p)
    return np.array([forward - TARGET_KL, backward - TARGET_KL])


initial_guess = np.array([1.0 / 14.0, np.exp(-10.0)])
solution = root(equations, initial_guess, method="hybr", options={"xtol": 1e-12})
if not solution.success:
    raise RuntimeError(solution.message)

p = build_distribution(*solution.x)
forward, backward = kl_divergences(p)

if not np.all(p > 0.0) or not np.isclose(p.sum(), 1.0, atol=1e-12):
    raise RuntimeError("Invalid probability distribution")
if abs(forward - TARGET_KL) > TOLERANCE or abs(backward - TARGET_KL) > TOLERANCE:
    raise RuntimeError("KL divergence targets were not met")

np.save(OUTPUT_PATH, p)
print(f"saved {OUTPUT_PATH}")
print(f"forward KL(P||U) = {forward:.12f}")
print(f"backward KL(U||P) = {backward:.12f}")
print(f"sum = {p.sum():.12f}, min = {p.min():.6e}, max = {p.max():.6e}")
